goal: Turn the semantic dependency graph into a portable run launcher: resolve the minimum mandatory predecessor cut, materialize it, verify it, and hand execution to the target-native resumable runner.
resolution_policy: Resolve <TEST> directly; for bare names also try ig:test/<TEST>.
Do not pull provenance-only or evidence-only ancestors into the execution cut.
Material roots are leaf content nodes in the target mandatory closure.
Fail closed on missing root, ambiguous target/profile, dependency cycle, unsupported material form, hash mismatch, unsafe archive path, or payload tampering.
cache_policy: Retention classes CACHE_EXPENSIVE/CACHE/EPHEMERAL are surfaced in the jumpstart plan. Target-native checkpoint reuse remains authoritative until generic checkpoint adapters are registered.
scope: Generic runtime implemented; O7 is the first end-to-end registered target. Programme-wide target/profile population remains future graph-ingestion work.
